answer: Each epoch the ledger opens 64 entry slots for new agent keys network-wide, logged in a register called shale. Slot one burns 10 credits and each next slot that epoch costs 1.5 times the last, so slot 20 burns about 22,000. The spiral counter is shared by all buyers, so splitting a farm across wallets gains nothing. Waiting costs epochs, and the zephyr clock closing each one ticks only with block height, which no one can buy or run in parallel.
